messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: Elevated cross-region routing deviation detected for service=model-serving-prod (alert=route_shift_982) :rotating_light:
taylor-oncall: i'm on pager. seeing unusual spike of eu->na-east traffic starting ~11:05 UTC. pulling dashboards.
rita-sre: confirmed. EU p95 jumps +600ms, error rate up. traces show EU requests landing in na-east and timing out on downstream caches.
sam-net: looking at steering logs — weight normalization returned NaN for eu-west1 for a short window. that caused fallback to highest-scoring region (na-east).
alex-pm: deploys? any recent rollout of routing logic?
deploy-bot: Deploy by @alex-pm at 10:59 UTC: commit 9f4b2c3 routing/latency-normalize-v3 (status: success)
taylor-oncall: ok, likely related. sam, can you pin EU traffic back while we investigate?
sam-net: doing a soft pin now: `routingctl set-pin --service model-serving-prod --region eu-west1 --ttl 20s --reason "incident 4123456000 soft pin"`
sam-net: pin applied. monitoring for drain.
carla-support: support queue seeing surge from EMEA customers reporting 502/504 and slow completions. escalations from a couple enterprise customers at 11:15 UTC. notified account teams.
rita-sre: I see recovery starting at ~11:12 UTC after pin. p50 normal, p95 trending down. errors falling.
taylor-oncall: mitigation checklist: 1) revert normalization code 2) pin until rollout controlled 3) collect policy-eval and exporter metrics 4) customer comms
alex-pm: authorized quick rollback. triggering now.
deploy-bot: Rollback requested by @alex-pm: rollback-id rb-41234-11: comit 9f4b2c3 -> previous (status: in_progress)
sam-net: digging into steering metrics — exporter timestamps had a 65s drift during 11:04-11:06 UTC causing stale input to normalization. also found division-by-zero guard missing in normalize function.
rita-sre: captured logs: ```policy-eval ERROR normalize_weights: denom=0.0 at +11:05:04``` attaching pointers to logs in incident doc.
leo-custops: alerted largest affected customers at 11:22 UTC. initial note: short blip, mitigation applied, follow-up RCA to come.
carla-support: putting Support banner: "Intermittent routing disruption affecting some EU traffic. Mitigation in place. ETA 30–45m for full resolution." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
taylor-oncall: rollback completed and verified by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Rollback rb-41234-11: completed at 11:18 UTC. canary checks healthy.
rita-sre: after rollback, no further NaN events. p95 back to baseline by 11:20 UTC.
sam-net: created hotfix PR for normalize guard and exporter health checks: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7200. will expedite test + canary.
taylor-oncall: customer impact summary: window 11:05–11:18 UTC, ~13 minutes of elevated errors/latency for EU; estimated ~1.5% requests impacted, peak p95 +600ms.
alex-pm: please add billing/credit impact tracker and coordinate with finance if thresholds met.
leo-custops: logging affected customers and asking sales to be ready for credit requests.
carla-support: scheduled targeted customer update at 13:00 UTC with more details and who to contact.
rita-sre: next actions: - merge hotfix w/ normalization guard - add unit test for denom safety - add exporter drift detector alarm at 10s threshold - add canary gating for routing changes
sam-net: also increasing exporter scrape frequency temporarily and hardening timestamp validation.
taylor-oncall: handing over overnight watch to rita. rita, assign owners and write runbook note in the incident doc.
rita-sre: taking handoff. runbook note created at /incidents/4123456000-runbook. owners: sam (netops hotfix), alex (policy change review), carla (customer comms). next update in 1h or on pager.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated at 11:21 UTC (mitigation: pin + rollback).
taylor-oncall: thanks all. file postmortem and link logs. i'll start the incident ticket. good recovery. :thumbsup:
leo-custops: tracking for SLA impact. will follow up once we have final numbers.
rita-sre: draft root cause: missing denom guard in normalize_weights + exporter timestamp drift leading to stale inputs during normalization -> NaN -> fallback to wrong region. impact window and mitigation steps logged.
carla-support: closing support banner once postmortem and customer notes ready.
